meta.name: opencode-qa
meta.description: QA opencode itself, per case: verify the CLI/terminal (opencode run, db, serve, export), prove a specific plugin hook/action/event fired via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in opencode's SQLite DB by id, title/name, or message text. Ships tested helper scripts (each with a --self-test) plus per-domain references. Use whenever someone wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or to find/inspect opencode sessions in the database. Triggers: opencode qa, qa opencode, test opencode, verify opencode hook, opencode session db, find opencode session by id/name/text, opencode tui test, opencode server health, opencode event stream.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后,Claude 会检查 opencode 本身是否正常:运行命令行指令、验证插件事件、查看历史会话等,还会在隔离环境里测试交互界面。附带能自检的脚本和参考文档。
howto.when: 当你说出“测试 opencode”“验证 opencode hook”“查 opencode 会话”等,或要求检查/调试它的命令行、HTTP 服务或插件事件等时触发。

say.text: 帮我冒烟测试一下 opencode 的界面。
say.note: 会在隔离环境里启动它的界面,确认能正常显示和接收输入。

say.text: 按 ID 查一下会话 ses_abc123 的完整记录。
say.note: 按 ID 只读查数据库,并把会话导出成 JSON。

say.text: 验证某个插件 hook 事件有没有触发。
say.note: 会监听事件流,触发一次动作来确认事件到达。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude QA opencode itself: run CLI commands, prove plugin events over SSE, inspect sessions in the SQLite DB, and smoke-test the TUI in tmux. It ships self-testing scripts and references.
howto.when_en: Use when someone wants to QA, smoke-test, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin events, etc., or inspect sessions in its database. Examples: 'opencode qa', 'test opencode', 'find opencode session'.

say_en.text: Smoke-test the opencode TUI for me.
say_en.note: Launches TUI in isolated tmux; checks render and key input.

say_en.text: Find the full session record for ses_abc123.
say_en.note: Read-only DB lookup by ID and exports the session as JSON.

say_en.text: Verify whether a plugin hook event actually fired.
say_en.note: Attaches to SSE; triggers one action to confirm event.
